<#if profileDetail.status == "ERRORED" || profileDetail.status == "WARNING" || profileDetail.status == "FAILED">
{
  "blocks": [
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": "${tenant}: Asset *${assets.name}* - Profiling Failed"
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "divider"
    },
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": "*Summary : *"
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "context",
      "elements": [
        {
          "type": "plain_text",
          "text": "Asset name: ${assets.name}"
        },
        {
          "type": "plain_text",
          "text": "Profiling type: ${profileDetail.profilingType}"
        },
        {
          "type": "plain_text",
          "text": "Start time: ${acceldata_dateFormat(profileDetail.createdAt)}"
        },
        {
          "type": "plain_text",
          "text": "End time: ${acceldata_dateFormat(profileDetail.updatedAt)}"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "actions",
      "elements": [
        {
          "type": "button",
          "text": {
            "type": "plain_text",
            "text": "Click Here For Details",
            "emoji": true
          },
          "value": "click_me_123",
          "url": "${link}"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "divider"
    }
  ]
}
